notes: Official sources could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and textbookcorp.tn.gov.in refuse the fetch tool (robots.txt); tnschools.gov.in and scert.tnschools.gov.in are JavaScript apps that return no content to the fetch tool; the sandbox shell has no internet access. All chapter information comes from secondary sites, so every chapter is verified:false.

For 2026-27, Classes 4-5 still use the existing Samacheer Kalvi term books (the syllabus revision introduced 2019-20). DT Next (7 May 2026) reports that books for Classes 4-12 are being produced 'still following the old syllabus', and that new-curriculum books for those classes are targeted for 2027-28. Expect a full change of this grade's books in 2027-28.
Chapter titles are consistent across BrainKart, Shaalaa and selfstudys. They are still verified:false because no official PDF or table of contents could be opened.

Section lists are BrainKart's topic headings with 'Exercise n.n' entries removed; wording may differ slightly from the printed headings. The exact printed edition statement (e.g. 'Revised Edition 20xx' or 'Reprint 2026') was not seen.

Proposed-competency ids reuse ids already proposed in other syllabus files (cbse-g01..g08, tn-g06) when the skill is the same, e.g. even-odd, calendar, 24-hour-clock, compute-with-measures, systematic-enumeration, transformations, maps-directions, fraction-of-collection, hcf-lcm, mixed-fractions, angle-pairs, rounding. Grade ranges are widened to include this grade; prerequisites are copied from the first proposal. MATH.statistics.pie-charts (from cbse-g08) lists percentage and angle prerequisites that suit drawing pie charts but are too strong for TN's Grade 4 reading of simple pie charts; review this when merging.
Ennum Ezhuthum: 2026-27 Ennum Ezhuthum lesson plans and notes of lesson exist for Classes 4-5 (kalviimayam.com, kalviseithiofficial.com). They support the same textbook and do not replace it.

Grade 5 has 6 units in Term 1, 6 in Term 2 and 7 in Term 3, per BrainKart. Term 1 and Term 2 unit counts and titles are cross-checked with Shaalaa (Term 2 from search-result chapter URLs); selfstudys.com agrees for Term 1.

Term 2 Unit 6 'Information Processing' has only one listed section, 'Modelling'. Its exact content (route map, plan or other model) is unclear, so its outcome is worded broadly and the maps-routes mapping is tentative.
Term 3 Unit 1 'Geometry' covers perimeter and area of rectangles and squares, as BrainKart lists it under Geometry.
selfstudys.com labels its Grade 5 PDFs 'New Textbooks 2020-21'. The imprint of the copy in schools in 2026-27 is unknown.
